notes: Same machine class as before (cloud container, offscreen); same commands for fake_1, slow, real_1 as perf-before.json v2 (5 runs).
--disk-delay-ms 20 wraps each renderer call (the pdfium render with --real); it finished in a normal time at 20 ms, no smaller value was needed.

Memory ceilings are RLIMIT_AS (virtual) applied after Qt start-up. Virtual size of the 1000-page fake run is about 1054 MB, RSS about 211 MB. 1500 (margin) and 1100 complete with all metrics unchanged; 1000 and 900 also completed in single probes; 800 (tight) starts and exits cleanly but in 2 of 3 runs loads 0 % of visible rows (median settled_loaded_pct_real 0; the third run 100): the thumbnail loading fails near the edge of the address-space cap, probably when a worker thread cannot be created. The tight case is reported as a limit, not a regression: the app needs about 1 GB of address space just for Qt.
Real-PDF RSS (~1170-1185 MB) is held by job creation/analysis (ledger B-040), not the thumbnail cache.
Real 800-page scans with OCR on/off are the owner's (Task C).
